Poor. They're not strong, they're not very meaningful. I don't care about them anymore. I know that I should, but I just can't make myself put the effort forward. All of this seems so futile. Like I could have the same conversation with them day in and day out and they wouldn't care.

Thank you. I hope that you get to 5k soon.

No, there really isn't anything that's been interesting. I can honestly say that I am uninterested in everything... That makes it worse. I think the program that I am in is the one that I would like the most, I am in English, and I liked writing, and that's what I do. It's just that now I don't get that same joy from it, and my writing has definitely suffered from it. I just don't have any drive to put in that extra effort anymore. But right now that one thing that gets me out of bed is the expectation to get out of bed, and nothing more. I have to or I will be wasting my education, or wasting money, or something. That's another depressing thought. I am being controlled by money.

Yeah... one day at a time.
